title: Unit Event — Kick It Up a Notch — Episode6 The Ones Watching Over

meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD is all set to perform at "Crawl Green" and are very excited about it. Kohane and the others are also looking forward to seeing Taiga there, but he happens to get a phone call which...

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay, here are your pancakes.
Extra whipped cream for yours, Kohane, An. Plenty of fruit for Akito and a grilled cheese for Toya. I believe that's everything.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you very much, Miku, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Let's dig in!
Mmm! Sooo good! I feel re-energized already!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What did you all do today?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We went to meet with the owner of Crawl Green. It's the venue where we'll be having our next event.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wait, Crawl Green...? Isn't that where Akito...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes, the very same.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's not somewhere your average musician is able to perform at, but An and the others did a good job negotiating a deal for us to put on our event there.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wow! That's wonderful to hear!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Not only that, An's dad and Taiga, Kohane's teacher, are coming to see you guys, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
R-Really?!
They are?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: On top of that, Kohane's gonna go solo as the opening act!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: S-So much happened while I was gone...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wait, Kohane, what led you to doing this?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Taiga suggested that, given where I am now, I might discover something by performing solo at an event we're hosting...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see... Then, this is going to be an important event for everyone and not just Akito!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, it is!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Still, Shiraishi, I'm glad you invited us along today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: After actually seeing it for myself, I see now why everyone reveres it so much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's both spacious and well-equipped. Not only that, the owner clearly has a strong passion for music.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, he does. Also, I didn't realize that he held my dad and his team in such high regard.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh? Care to elaborate on that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, he told us this story about when Uncle Taiga was much younger...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
Which is why he cares so much about RADder...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah... Again, Kohane, I'm really sorry... I didn't mean for him to put more pressure on you...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. It's okay, An, really.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, it's just... Before we met up at Crawl Green, An and I hung out a little together.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanted to give Kohane some time to relax since she's been practicing nonstop lately.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
So, how was your little date?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really fun!
But...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: After walking around with An and hearing the owner of Crawl Green tell that story, I realized something.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I understand now that everyone there has been watching over both Taiga and An since they were little...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which I think is so beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, whether it's when Taiga's talking to people passing by or An's singing in front of everyone, they glow with this bright aura...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A bright aura...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Is that how you felt that time, Kohane...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, because I never had what you and Taiga did. I only ever had my family watch over me as I grew up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, now that you mention it, that is quite rare. Even more so if you think about how music ties all those people together...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, that's what I mean.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Lately, I've been going on more walks with An and practicing with Taiga around the city.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Each time, it feels like they lead me somewhere filled with so much warmth.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So, someday...
I'm hoping that I'm also able to make those kinds of personal connections...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see... That's a wonderful thought, and I'm sure you'll be able to, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: I still remember when Ken and his team performed there. I wanted to sing there way back when, but I never got a chance to...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: If you're that prepared, then I only have one thing to say to all of you. Put on the best event ever for me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: RADder's first event was so big that it changed this city forever... So, I don't know if we'll actually be able to do better than them...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But if we're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND, like the owner of Crawl Green said, we need to put on the best event ever...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's my feeling...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which is why I'd like you all to watch me practice by myself.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? Now...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. I've been having some trouble, and I want to become as good as possible...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know today's our day off, so I feel bad about making you all help me practice. But...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Don't feel bad.
I mean, it's our event too...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, we're happy to help however we can!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you all so much! I really appreciate it...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, here I go...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: She's off to a good start...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, she's doing much better than she did yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm going to stand on that live house stage I saw today...by myself...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's a little bigger than the one at COL, and it uses brighter lights... I'm so glad that I actually got to see it today.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I was able to picture how far and in what way my voice will reach when I sing with everything I have... My practices with Taiga may be paying off...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But there's a gap between the stage and the audience. I'll need to project a little better than usual if I'm going to reach everyone.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It'll be fairly quiet in the beginning since the event will've just started. I have to get them warmed up by myself...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(No...! I did it again...!
I need to get back on track...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (If I don't succeed in getting everyone going here, they might end up watching our event without really being all that excited about it.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I don't want to be the one who ruins our event...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You sang with so much more power than usual! But... Well, you seemed to tense up a lot while you sang.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... Was it that noticeable?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes... I agree with Len.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Your voice... It usually has this effortless resounding quality, you know? You seemed to get stuck somewhere today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I agree.
You didn't perform badly or anything, but you didn't seem to hit your stride.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know...
I had a feeling that something was wrong partway through...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, there's no point in feeling this way. We still have some time, so all you have to do is figure it out before then...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Um, Kohane?
How about we sing together?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What? Right now...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes!
Let's try singing without thinking about anything else.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Your event, everyone you've met...
Just forget it all for this one song.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Forget it all...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, I like your idea.
Mind if I join you, Luka...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, Miku, wonderful!
Then, let's sing as a trio!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: As a trio? Which song are we going to sing...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Which song? Why not the one you just sang?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Alright, Kohane, take a deep breath for me... Gently breathe in... And breathe out...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We'll start singing while you do that, so give us the signal when you're ready.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(How's Luka able to do this...?
Her voice sounds raw but still crystal clear. And it only took her a second to create this incredible atmosphere.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wow! Miku sounds really ferocious today. But there's still that delicate touch, and it goes so well with the way Luka's singing!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I... I need to join them!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: All in a second... Those two really are something else. It's hard to believe that they're improvising.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Luka's natural talent is one thing, but Miku's also doing an impressive job of keeping up with her.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: On top of that, they seem to have been able to bring in Azusawa at just the right time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They're both so good...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(But they're not just good.
They're in perfect sync with one another and even taking turns to look towards me.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's like they're trying to tell me how I can sing certain parts. I couldn't ask for more.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (So, if I try sounding more raw like Luka...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Oh... This seems much easier...
Is it because Miku's also helping...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Miku somehow snuck herself towards the back, but jumped back up front at just the right time. She's doing a really good job of supporting the others...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah. Also...
I didn't realize you could lead by being supportive like that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Kohane seems to be feeling much better now. You're just too good at this, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Huh? What happened...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Their song... It's like Luka and Miku are calling out to me...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Their singing... I can sense exactly how they feel for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (We want to hear you sing, Kohane!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (You can keep going, right?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Luka... Miku...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Thank you both so much.
Here's my answer...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane! That was amazing!
Way more amazing than how you usually sing!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. As you are now, you sound more than ready to be the opening act for our event.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I wish I could've sung with you...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You should do just fine by yourself! The way you sang just now was great, so please have confidence in yourself!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much, Luka.
But I was only able to sing that way because of you and Miku...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I felt this need to answer your calls... And it felt so fun that I couldn't help but do what I did...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, all we did was express how we felt. The rest was all you, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can guarantee that because we've been watching over all of you for so long now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you all so much...
